title: The entropy photon-number inequality for arbitrary finite-mode inputs
exact_target: For independent finite-energy n-mode bosonic inputs $\rho _A$ and $\rho _B$, any finite $n\geq 1$ and $0\leq \eta \leq 1$, let $\rho _C$ be the n output modes of passive beam-splitter mixing $c_j=\operatorname{sqrt}(\eta )a_j+\operatorname{sqrt}(1-\eta )b_j$. Is $g^{-1}(S(\rho _C)/n)\geq \eta $ $g^{-1}(S(\rho _A)/n)+(1-\eta )g^{-1}(S(\rho _B)/n)$, where $g(x)=(x+1)\log (x+1)-x$ log x? Internal entanglement between modes within either input is permitted.
